 def _build_component_07():
+    from itertools import combinations
+
+    def solve(data):
+        k = data["k"]
+        blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+        mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+        options = [job for job in data["jobs"] if job["id"] not in blocked]
+        quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+        best_value = None
+        best_ids = None
+
+        for group in combinations(options, k):
+            ids = {job["id"] for job in group}
+            if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+                continue
+            counts = {}
+            for job in group:
+                counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+            if any(not low <= counts.get(name, 0) <= high
+                   for name, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+                continue
+            ordered = sorted(group, key=lambda job: (job["start"], job["end"], job["id"]))
+            active = []
+            feasible = True
+            for job in ordered:
+                active = [end for end in active if end > job["start"]]
+                active.append(job["end"])
+                if len(active) > 2:
+                    feasible = False
+                    break
+            if not feasible:
+                continue
+            chosen_ids = sorted(ids)
+            value = sum(job["value"] for job in group)
+            if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                    (value == best_value and chosen_ids < best_ids)):
+                best_value, best_ids = value, chosen_ids
+
+        if best_value is None:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+        return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
+    return solve
